target_scope: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx, Inc., Reg CF offering file no. 020-37299, US, at least one closing with proceeds released to the issuer
allowed_evidence: ["Form C-U", "Form C-AR", "Form C/A", "Republic deal page", "SEC EDGAR filing by the issuer"]
rationale: The target is only $75,000 and the Form C XML deadline is 2026-11-27, but the pack does not show that the offering is live, its launch date or any commitments. The pack reports no closing to date. The mouse-only evidence, the 10-year proxy and the going-concern warning argue against strong demand. The probability is a judgment, not a base rate.
assumptions: ["The offering is live on Republic", "The deadline is not extended beyond 2026-12-31", "Reporting occurs within 30 days"]
unknown_treatment: If no filing or platform report is found by the deadline plus lag, the result is unknown and not false.
cancellation_treatment: If the offering is cancelled, withdrawn (Form C-W) or the issuer dissolves before a closing, the event is false for this definition; a cancellation after a closing does not reverse it.

target_scope: Hope-Neuron Therapeutx, Inc., human ALS trial of SELtx, any US IRB, approval granted (not an IND, FDA clearance or dosing)
allowed_evidence: ["Clinical trial registry entry", "Letter or statement from the IRB or clinical site", "Third-party news report"]
rationale: The Form C lists the IRB trial as a planned step that depends on funding, and the pack shows no device procurement or IRB submission. Funding at the target would allocate only $30,000 to clinical trials. IRB approval is distinct from an FDA IND and first dosing, and neither is assumed here.
assumptions: ["No IRB approval existed before the 2026-10-14 cutoff", "Funding is not yet sufficient"]
unknown_treatment: Absent independent confirmation by the deadline plus lag, the result is unknown and not false.
cancellation_treatment: Offering cancellation or withdrawal does not make the event false by itself; dissolution of the issuer before approval makes it false.

target_scope: Mightylicious Inc, Reg CF offering via OpenDeal Portal LLC dba Republic, SEC file no. 020-37424, United States; threshold: commitments of at least $75,000
allowed_evidence: ["Form C-U or Form C/A filed on SEC EDGAR", "Republic deal page (republic.com/mightylicious) status update", "Issuer press release or investor email"]
rationale: The $75,000 target is small relative to the $1,000,000 maximum, and the issuer says it has a prior investor base and an active campaign (issuer press release, unverified). Offsetting this, the offering's availability is unconfirmed, the issuer's own materials are inconsistent about whether it is live, and a going-concern paragraph may deter investors.
assumptions: ["The campaign is actually open on Republic", "No material change forces reconfirmation that stalls commitments", "Issuer or platform publicly posts progress"]
unknown_treatment: If no public report is found by the deadline plus the reporting lag, resolve as unknown, not false.
cancellation_treatment: If the offering is cancelled, withdrawn (Form C-W) or the issuer dissolves before reaching the target, this event resolves false only if no earlier announcement of reaching the target exists; an earlier true announcement stays true.

target_scope: Mightylicious Inc, Reg CF offering via OpenDeal Portal LLC dba Republic, SEC file no. 020-37424, filed on SEC EDGAR
allowed_evidence: ["Form C-W on SEC EDGAR", "Republic deal page status"]
rationale: Issuers rarely withdraw when the target is small and the company states the proceeds are essential to operations. The unconfirmed availability, going-concern language and inconsistent testing-the-waters disclaimers leave some chance of withdrawal or restructuring.
assumptions: ["No regulatory or platform action halts the offering", "The issuer does not replace the offering with a new Form C"]
unknown_treatment: If EDGAR filings cannot be checked, resolve as unknown, not false.
cancellation_treatment: A Form C-W filing is the event itself and resolves true; a deadline lapse without reaching the target, with funds returned, is not a Form C-W and does not count unless a Form C-W is filed.

target_scope: TradeFunded LLC, Form C accession 0002128340-26-000005, offering file no. 020-37393, US Reg CF offering via OpenDeal Portal LLC (Republic); at least $74,999.75 closed.
allowed_evidence: ["Form C-U or Form C-AR filed on EDGAR reporting progress or results", "Issuer or Republic Deal Page update showing a closing", "Later SEC EDGAR filings by the issuer"]
rationale: The target is small relative to the maximum, but the pack contains no commitment data, no traction and no platform availability confirmation; the stated cancellation condition applies if the target is not met by the deadline. No base rate is in the pack, so this is a judgment under high uncertainty.
assumptions: ["The offering is actually live on the platform", "The deadline is not extended beyond 2026-12-15 before closing", "No material change forces reconfirmation that cancels commitments"]
unknown_treatment: If no closing evidence is found by the deadline plus reporting lag, resolve as unknown rather than false; silence is not false.
cancellation_treatment: A withdrawal (Form C-W), cancellation, failure to reach the target, or company dissolution before a closing means the event did not occur and resolves false once confirmed; an extension past the deadline without a closing is unresolved.

target_scope: TradeFunded LLC, offering file no. 020-37393, filing on SEC EDGAR, United States.
allowed_evidence: ["Form C-W filed on SEC EDGAR", "Issuer or Republic Deal Page notice of withdrawal or cancellation"]
rationale: The issuer states it can end or withdraw the offering and will return funds if a Form C-W is filed. Nothing in the pack suggests a withdrawal is planned; the low estimate reflects only the absence of any such indication, not a base rate.
assumptions: ["No material adverse development, such as IRS or regulatory action, forces withdrawal", "The offering remains open through the deadline"]
unknown_treatment: If no Form C-W is found, resolve as not occurred only after the deadline plus lag; absence of evidence before then stays unknown.
cancellation_treatment: This event is itself the withdrawal; an offering that lapses unfunded at the deadline without a Form C-W filing does not count as true.
